'''Adapted Vermin''' are a type of [[Mobs|Mob]], placed into the [[Adapted Parasites|Adapted]] Tier.

==''Spawning''==

==''Behavior''==
Adapted Vermin are a flying, bombarding, swarm summoning unit, they will chase and hover above the player when attacking.

*Adapted Vermin hover above the player dropping [[Lice]].
**When the number of Lice exceeds 40, it will drop bombs instead.
*In certain circumstances, Adapted Vermin can apply contact damage, though they make no effort to do so.

===''Weaknesses''===
Adapted Vermin, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.

=== ''Post Death'' ===

* On death, Adapted Vermin have a chance to explode, releasing [[Remains|Adapted Remains]] and an effect cloud of stacking Poison and [[Call Of The Hive|COTH]].
** Unconventionally, if at least one [[Colony]] exists in the dimension, Adapted Vermin will become [[Moving Flesh]] upon death instead.
***It is the only [[Adapted Parasites|Adapted Parasite]] to do this, as usually Adapted Parasites turn into their Primitive counterpart and [[Primitive Parasites]] turn into Moving Flesh.

==''Trivia''==

* The [[Compendium]] states that an Adapted Vermin can crush steel with its jaws; however, steel is not a material that appears in Vanilla Minecraft or the SRP mod<ref>With its crooked and fairly thin teeth, it doesn't look much like it.</ref>.
